description:
## Problem
Curated profiles exist (`examples/tunings/dataframe/polars_optimized.yaml`, `pandas_optimized.yaml`, `cudf_optimized.yaml`, `dask_distributed.yaml`, …). But `--tuning tuned` searches `<platform>/<benchmark>_tuned.yaml` (`benchbox/cli/tuning_resolver.py` `get_tuning_template_paths`), so it always resolves `tuned-fallback`. On Polars that fallback applied three streaming-runtime settings, while the console said "using basic constraints".

## Must decide
- The resolution rule and its precedence.
- The ADR-002 facet: does such a resolution report `tuned` or a distinct facet?

## Guardrails
- A fallback must never facet-match a curated run (ADR-002).

## Gate protocol
- This is a decision record, not an implementation.
- Implementation items that list this gate in `needs` must not start until it is done.
- The decision owner is the maintainer.
- Record the outcome as a dated ADR addendum (addenda only; do not rewrite recorded decisions) and paste the decision into this item's context before finishing.
